text: Can you add English subtitles to the attached clip? I’m a little worried that subtitles might make it feel cluttered, but I’d really like to be able to follow what she’s saying. What I mean is, please use all 10 seconds of the clip and faithfully transcribe the woman’s speech in English. I want the subtitles visible on the exported video itself, rather than just getting a transcript or a separate subtitle file. The style and placement are your call, as long as they’re readable and stay away from her face. Please keep the original framing, and free-tier 480p is fine. Keep the original voice and sound too, without adding music or narration.
